params.prompt: Hand-drawn ink illustration on pure black paper, in the style of a fine etching: thin white and light-grey pen lines with dense crosshatching, high contrast, deep black negative space. Match the drawing technique and the robot character design of the reference image exactly (same rounded helmet-like head, same big glowing yellow oval eyes, same jointed body), but a new scene. The only color is electric yellow #FDD506, used for the robot's two glowing oval eyes and the faint glow of its phone screen. A small friendly robot agent (rounded helmet-like head, two big glowing yellow oval eyes, compact jointed body, slightly worn) sits on the ridge of a pitched tiled roof of a British red-brick terraced house at dusk in light rain, shoulders slumped. It holds a smartphone showing a few empty chat bubbles and looks at it with honest, slightly humorous disappointment. Chimney pots and a few loosely sketched rooftops of a northern English city behind it. The house and roof are drawn in white ink lines only, no red color. Composition: robot and roof fill the right and lower 65% of a square frame; the top-left fades to pure black so the image blends into a black slide. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no green.
